notes.page_content: The sheet writes the opening U_s inclusion and barred-U nonemptiness expression, a U_s equality with an indexed large union and hatted positive Sigma, then a component condition and disjointness wording. It says “Il faut voir que” K setminus braced i and the Sigma-alpha-plus family are determined in terms of i and Sigma-i-plus, followed by “i.e.” Sigma-i-minus. The final written equality ends with E_alpha subset Sigma_alpha-minus and has no closing set brace. These are attributed manuscript expressions, not proof checks.
